kind.description: The matching kind, such as Equals, Contains, StartsWith, or EndsWith.

value.description: The text that the submitted search term is compared against. Depending on Kind, the search term must equal, contain, start with, or end with this value.

minimumLength.description: Optional minimum search-term length required for this condition.

negated.description: Whether the condition result is inverted.

nestedConditionCount.description: Total number of nested AND and OR conditions directly attached to the root condition. Get the rule by ID to inspect their definitions.

description: Compact representation of the root Search Term condition without its nested condition definitions.
